outputs.summary_en: The image announces a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' stating that the government is providing free laptops to all students. It mentions October 15 as the last date to apply and directs users to click a link (www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in) to register. The post also asks users to forward it to all groups.

outputs.visual_description_en: The image features Hindi text on a white background with an orange header. The header contains the text 'बड़ी खुशखबरी' (Big Good News) flanked by two square emojis. The main body of the text announces a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' for all students, stating that free laptops are being provided by the government. It specifies the last date for application as October 15 and instructs users to click a provided link (www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in) to register. The bottom of the image has a red text asking to forward the message to all groups.
